question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Frugal".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Extravagant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Frugal" means economical and careful with money or resources. (मितव्ययी)

◦ Example: Her frugal habits allowed her to save a significant portion of her modest monthly salary.

 

• "Extravagant" means spending much more money or resources than necessary, and is therefore the correct antonym. (फिजूलखर्च)

◦ Example: The extravagant wedding included fireworks, imported flowers, and a lavish seven-course dinner for guests.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sparing (कम इस्तेमाल करने वाला): using or giving little; economical — a synonym of frugal, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Economical (किफायती): giving good value; not wasteful — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Thrifty (कम खर्च करने वाला): careful and economical with money — close in sense to frugal.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of frugal: Thrifty, Economical, Sparing, Prudent, Austere.

• Synonyms of extravagant: Wasteful, Lavish, Excessive, Profligate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fallacy (गलत धारणा): Truth (सत्य), Fact (तथ्य)

2. Falter (हिचकना): Persist (दृढ़ रहना), Continue (जारी रखना)

3. Fancy (सजावटी): Simple (सरल), Plain (सादा)

4. Fastidious (अत्यंत सावधान): Sloppy (लापरवाह), Careless (बेपरवाह)

5. Felicitous (उपयुक्त): Unfortunate (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण), Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Humble".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Arrogant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Humble" means having or showing a modest estimate of one's own importance. (विनम्र)

◦ Example: Despite winning the championship, the young athlete remained humble and credited his entire team for the victory.

 

• "Arrogant" means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities, and is therefore the correct antonym. (घमंडी)

◦ Example: His arrogant manner during the interview left the panel with a poor impression of his character.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Meek (विनीत): quiet, gentle, and submissive — a synonym of humble, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Modest (विनम्र): unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Unassuming (निरभिमानी): not seeking to attract attention; modest — close in sense to humble.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of humble: modest, meek, unassuming, unpretentious, lowly.

• Synonyms of arrogant: haughty, proud, conceited, pompous, supercilious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Felicity (सुख): Misery (दुःख), Unhappiness (असंतोष)

2. Fertile (उपजाऊ): Barren (बंजर), Desolate (उजाड़)

3. Fetid (बदबूदार): Fragrant (सुगंधित), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Fetish (अत्यधिक लगाव): Indifference (उदासीनता), Detachment (विरक्ति)

5. Feud (झगड़ा): Harmony (सामंजस्य), Peace (शांति)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Obsequious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Assertive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Obsequious" means excessively eager to please or obey; fawning. (चापलूस)

◦ Example: The obsequious waiter kept complimenting every customer in hopes of a bigger tip.

 

• "Assertive" means confidently expressing oneself without being aggressive, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आत्मविश्वासी)

◦ Example: Her assertive response in the meeting left no doubt about her position on the proposal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sycophantic (चापलूसी करने वाला): flattering others to gain favor — a synonym of obsequious, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Servile (दास जैसा): excessively submissive or obedient — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Ingratiating (चापलूसी भरा): attempting to win approval by flattery — close in sense to obsequious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of obsequious: servile, sycophantic, fawning, ingratiating, toadying.

• Synonyms of assertive: confident, forceful, self-assured, assured, bold.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fictitious (काल्पनिक): Real (वास्तविक), Factual (तथ्यात्मक)

2. Fidelity (वफादारी): Treachery (विश्वासघात), Disloyalty (बेईमानी)

3. Fiendish (दुष्ट): Friendly (मित्रवत), Kind (दयालु)

4. Filthy (गंदा): Clean (साफ), Pure (शुद्ध)

5. Flee (भागना): Stay (रुकना), Remain (ठहरना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Quell."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Provoke.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Quell" means to put an end to a rebellion or disturbance, usually by force. (दबाना)

 

• "Provoke" means to stimulate or incite someone into a reaction. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भड़काना)

◦ Example: His sarcastic remarks were clearly intended to provoke a fight among the frustrated commuters.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Subdue (वश में करना) — to overcome or bring under control; a synonym of quell.

• Option 3: Extinguish (बुझाना) — to put out completely, as a fire; a synonym of quell.

• Option 4: Suppress (दबाना) — to forcibly put an end to something; a synonym of quell.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of quell: Agitate, Incite, Instigate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Flexible (लचीला): Rigid (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त)

2. Florid (चमकदार): Plain (साधारण), Pale (फीका)

3. Foment (उकसाना): Quash (दबाना), Suppress (रोकना)

4. Foolish (मूर्ख): Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार)

5. Forbade (मनाही की): Allowed (अनुमति दी), Permitted (इजाजत दी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Hardly ever."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Frequently.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Hardly ever" means happening very rarely; almost never occurring. (बहुत कम)

 

• "Frequently" means happening often or at short intervals; many times. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अक्सर)

◦ Example: Heavy traffic frequently causes long delays on this stretch of the busy national highway.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Rarely (शायद ही कभी) — not often; infrequently; a synonym of hardly ever.

• Option 2: Infrequently (कभी-कभार) — not occurring often; rarely; a synonym of hardly ever.

• Option 3: Seldom (कभी-कभार) — not often; rarely; a synonym of hardly ever.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of hardly ever: Often, Regularly, Commonly.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Forbid (मना करना): Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (इजाजत देना)

2. Forbidden (निषिद्ध): Allowed (अनुमति), Permitted (स्वीकृत)

3. Foremost (सबसे महत्वपूर्ण): Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Minor (छोटा)

4. Forever (हमेशा): Temporarily (अस्थायी), Briefly (संक्षेप में)

5. Forgive (माफ़ करना): Loathe (घृणा करना), Condemn (दोष देना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Oppugn".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Defend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Oppugn" means to call into question or dispute the truth of something. (विरोध करना)

◦ Example: The lawyer sought to oppugn the credibility of the prosecution's key witness during cross-examination.

 

• "Defend" means to resist an attack made on someone or something; to protect, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बचाव करना)

◦ Example: The lawyer worked tirelessly to defend her client against the serious charges brought by the prosecution.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Impugn (आक्षेप करना): to call into question the integrity of — a synonym of oppugn, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Contest (विवाद करना): to dispute or challenge something — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Challenge (चुनौती देना): to question the truth of something — close in sense to oppugn.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of oppugn: Contest, Challenge, Impugn, Dispute, Question.

• Synonyms of defend: Protect, Support, Shield, Guard, Uphold.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Forgo (त्यागना): Conquer (प्राप्त करना/जीतना)

2. Former (पूर्व): Current (वर्तमान), Present (वर्तमान)

3. Fortunately (सौभाग्य से): Unfortunately (दुर्भाग्य से), Sadly (दुखद)

4. Frighten (डराना): Comfort (सांत्वना देना), Calm (शांत करना)

5. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Desolate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Festive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Desolate" means deserted and bleak, or feeling utterly lonely and sad. (उजाड़/निराश)

 

• "Festive" means relating to or characteristic of a celebration; joyous. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्सवपूर्ण)

◦ Example: The entire neighborhood took on a festive atmosphere with colorful lights and music during the Diwali celebrations.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Bleak (उजाड़) — lacking warmth or cheer; bare; a synonym of desolate.

• Option 3: Forlorn (उदास) — pitifully sad and abandoned; a synonym of desolate.

• Option 4: Barren (बंजर) — empty and unproductive; bare; a synonym of desolate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of desolate: Cheerful, Joyous, Merry.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Furtive (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Overt (स्पष्ट)

2. Futile (व्यर्थ): Effective (प्रभावी), Useful (उपयोगी)

3. Gaining (प्राप्त करना): Losing (खोना), Forfeiting (त्यागना)

4. Garner (इकट्ठा करना): Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (फैलाना)

5. Garrulous (बातूनी): Reserved (संकोची), Quiet (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Disgusting."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Delightful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Disgusting" means causing a strong feeling of dislike or revulsion. (घिनौना)

 

• "Delightful" means causing great pleasure or satisfaction. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुखद)

◦ Example: We spent a delightful evening by the lake, watching the sunset with old friends.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Revolting (घृणित) — causing intense disgust; a synonym of disgusting.

• Option 3: Nauseating (मतली पैदा करने वाला) — causing a feeling of sickness; a synonym of disgusting.

• Option 4: Repulsive (घिनौना) — arousing strong dislike or disgust; a synonym of disgusting.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of disgusting: Pleasant, Charming, Agreeable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Get back (वापस पाना): Lose (खो देना), Miss (गंवा देना)

2. Get on (चढ़ना): Remain (रुकना), Stay (ठहरना)

3. Give away (दे देना): Keep (रखना), Save (बचाना)

4. Give back (वापस करना): Keep (रखना), Retain (संभालकर रखना)

5. Give up (हार मानना): Persist (डटे रहना), Continue (जारी रखना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Evade."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Confront.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Evade" means to escape or avoid someone or something by cleverness or deceit. (बचना)

 

• "Confront" means to face up to and deal with a problem or difficult situation. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सामना करना)

◦ Example: Rather than avoiding the issue any longer, the manager decided to confront her team about the recurring delays.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dodge (चकमा देना) — to avoid by moving quickly aside; a synonym of evade.

• Option 2: Sidestep (टालना) — to avoid dealing with an issue; a synonym of evade.

• Option 4: Elude (बचना) — to escape from or avoid skillfully; a synonym of evade.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of evade: Face, Tackle, Address.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Glanced (झलक देखना): Stared (घूरना), Gazed (टकटकी लगाना)

2. Glut (भरमार): Starve (भूखा रहना), Shortage (कमी)

3. Go on (जारी रखना): Stop (रोकना), Cease (बंद करना)

4. Grabbed (पकड़ लिया): Release (छोड़ना), Let go (मुक्त करना)

5. Gracious (दयालु): Miserable (दुखी/कठोर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Disheveled."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Tidy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Disheveled" means untidy or disordered in appearance, especially hair or clothing. (अस्त-व्यस्त)

 

• "Tidy" means arranged neatly and in good order. It is therefore the correct antonym. (साफ-सुथरा)

◦ Example: She always kept her desk tidy, with every file placed in its proper folder.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Unkempt (बेतरतीब) — not properly maintained, especially hair; a synonym of disheveled.

• Option 2: Messy (गंदा) — dirty or disorganized; a synonym of disheveled.

• Option 4: Untidy (अस्त-व्यस्त) — not neat or orderly; a synonym of disheveled.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of disheveled: Organized, Neat, Spruce.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Grapple (पकड़ना): Release (छोड़ना), Let go (त्यागना)

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Solitary (एकांतप्रिय), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

3. Grisly (डरावना): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Grotesque (घृणित/भद्दा): Attractive (आकर्षक), Plain (साधारण)

5. Grow (बढ़ना): Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Decline (कम होना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Truculent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Amiable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Truculent" means eager or quick to argue or fight; aggressively defiant. (लड़ाकू)

 

• "Amiable" means having a friendly and pleasant manner. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मिलनसार)

◦ Example: Their new neighbor turned out to be an amiable man who greeted everyone warmly each morning.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण) — unfriendly and antagonistic; a synonym of truculent.

• Option 3: Aggressive (आक्रामक) — ready to attack or confront; hostile; a synonym of truculent.

• Option 4: Belligerent (झगड़ालू) — hostile and aggressive; eager to fight; a synonym of truculent.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of truculent: Amicable, Friendly, Cordial.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Grudge (द्वेष): Benevolence (परोपकार), Kindness (दयालुता)

2. Gruesome (भयानक/कुरूप): Gracious (सुंदर/दयालु), Pleasant (सुखद)

3. Guiltiness (दोषी होना): Innocence (निर्दोषता), Purity (पवित्रता)

4. Guilty (दोषी): Innocent (निर्दोष)

5. Gullible (भोला): Cynical (संशयी), Wise (समझदार)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Chronic".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Temporary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Chronic" means persisting for a long time or constantly recurring. (पुराना)

◦ Example: The patient has been suffering from a chronic illness that requires regular medication and monitoring.

 

• "Temporary" means lasting for only a limited period of time, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्थायी)

◦ Example: The government introduced a temporary ban on plastic bags during the festival season.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Recurring (आवर्ती): occurring repeatedly — a synonym of chronic, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Persistent (लगातार): continuing firmly over a long time — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Lingering (बना रहने वाला): lasting for a long time — close in sense to chronic.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of chronic: persistent, lingering, recurring, constant, prolonged.

• Synonyms of temporary: momentary, transient, brief, fleeting, short-lived.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gumption (समझदारी): Stupidity (मूर्खता), Foolishness (बेवकूफी)

2. Haggard (थका हुआ): Fresh (ताज़ा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

3. Happy (खुश): Sad (दुखी), Unhappy (अप्रसन्न)

4. Harass (तंग करना): Comfort (सांत्वना देना), Support (सहायता करना)

5. Hardly ever (बहुत कम): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Antique."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Modern.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Antique" means old and valuable, typically dating from a much earlier period. (प्राचीन)

 

• "Modern" means relating to the present or recent times rather than the past. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आधुनिक)

◦ Example: The office was furnished with modern furniture that gave it a sleek, minimalist appearance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Ancient (प्राचीन) — belonging to the very distant past; a synonym of antique.

• Option 3: Archaic (पुरातन) — very old or old-fashioned; a synonym of antique.

• Option 4: Vintage (पुराना) — old, from an earlier and often valued period; a synonym of antique.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of antique: New, Current, Recent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण): Discordant (असंगत), Conflicting (विरोधी)

2. Harmony (एकता): Strife (कलह), Conflict (संघर्ष)

3. Hazard (जोखिम): Protection (सुरक्षा)

4. Heavy (भारी): Light (हल्का), Weightless (निर्वजन)

5. Hegemony (आधिपत्य): Subordination (अधीनता), Dependence (निर्भरता)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Turpitude."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Morality.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Turpitude" means depraved or wicked behavior or character. (अनैतिकता)

 

• "Morality" means principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong behavior. It is therefore the correct antonym. (नैतिकता)

◦ Example: The philosopher's lectures on morality examined how societies decide what counts as right and wrong.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Wickedness (दुष्टता) — the quality of being morally wrong or evil; a synonym of turpitude.

• Option 2: Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार) — dishonest or unethical conduct, especially by officials; a synonym of turpitude.

• Option 3: Depravity (भ्रष्टता) — the state of being morally corrupt or wicked; a synonym of turpitude.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of turpitude: Virtue, Righteousness, Integrity.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Heresy (विधर्म): Orthodoxy (परंपरागत विश्वास), Doctrine (सिद्धांत)

2. High (ऊँचा): Low (निम्न)

3. Hinder (रोकना): Facilitate (सहायता करना), Assist (मदद करना)

4. Hit (मारना): Miss (चूकना), Avoid (बचना)

5. Hollow (खाली): Worthwhile (मूल्यवान), Solid (ठोस)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Attack."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Defend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Attack" means an act of taking aggressive action against someone or something. (हमला)

 

• "Defend" means resist an attack made on someone or something; protect. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रक्षा करना)

◦ Example: The soldiers worked together to defend the border village against repeated raids from hostile forces.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Raid (छापा) — a sudden armed attack on an enemy position; a synonym of attack.

• Option 2: Offensive (आक्रामक अभियान) — an aggressive military campaign or attack; a synonym of attack.

• Option 4: Assault (हमला) — a violent physical or verbal attack; a synonym of attack.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of attack: Protect, Guard, Shield.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Horrible (भयानक): Pleasant (सुखद), Nice (अच्छा)

2. Hospitality (अतिथि सत्कार): Coldness (बेरुख़ी, ठंडापन)

3. Hostile (दुश्मनी): Amiable (मिलनसार), Friendly (मित्रवत)

4. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रतापूर्ण), Kind (दयालु)

5. Hot (गरम): Cold (ठंडा), Frigid (बहुत ठंडा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Amplify."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Reduce.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Amplify" means to increase the strength, volume, or intensity of something. (बढ़ाना)

 

• "Reduce" means to make something smaller in size, amount, or degree. It is therefore the correct antonym. (घटाना)

◦ Example: The company plans to reduce its workforce significantly amid falling quarterly profits.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Magnify (बढ़ाकर दिखाना) — to make something appear or seem larger; a synonym of amplify.

• Option 3: Boost (बढ़ावा देना) — to increase or improve something; a synonym of amplify.

• Option 4: Intensify (तीव्र करना) — to make something more intense; a synonym of amplify.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of amplify: Decrease, Contract.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी)

2. Humidity (नमी): Dryness (शुष्कता), Aridity (सूखापन)

3. Iconoclast (परंपरा तोड़ने वाला): Conformist (परंपरा मानने वाला), Traditionalist (परंपरावादी)

4. Ideal (आदर्श): Faulty (दोषपूर्ण), Imperfect (अपूर्ण)

5. Identity (पहचान): Anonymous (गुमनाम)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Minute".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Enormous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Minute" means extremely small in size or amount. (सूक्ष्म)

◦ Example: Under the microscope, even the most minute traces of pollen were clearly visible to researchers.

 

• "Enormous" means very large in size, quantity, or extent, and is therefore the correct antonym. (विशाल)

◦ Example: The construction company faced an enormous bill after the unexpected delays doubled the project's cost.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Tiny (बहुत छोटा): very small in size — a synonym of minute, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Minuscule (अत्यंत छोटा): extremely small — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Microscopic (सूक्ष्मदर्शीय): too small to see unaided — close in sense to minute.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of minute: Tiny, Minuscule, Microscopic, Miniature, Infinitesimal.

• Synonyms of enormous: Huge, Massive, Gigantic, Immense.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ignorance (अज्ञान): Knowledge (ज्ञान)

2. Imbroglio (उलझन / जटिल स्थिति): Agreement (समझौता), Harmony (सामंजस्य)

3. Imitate (नकल करना): Originate (मूल रूप से बनाना), Create (सृजन करना)

4. Immaculate (शुद्ध): Filthy (गंदा), Messy (अव्यवस्थित)

5. Immigration (आप्रवासन): Emigration (प्रवासन), Exit (निर्गमन)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Deleterious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Harmless.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Deleterious" means causing harm or damage, often in a subtle or gradual way. (हानिकारक)

◦ Example: Excessive exposure to pesticides can have deleterious effects on both farm workers and the surrounding environment.

 

• "Harmless" means not able or likely to cause harm or damage, and is therefore the correct antonym. (हानिरहित)

◦ Example: The scientist assured the public that the new food additive was completely harmless when consumed in moderation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Detrimental (हानिकर): tending to cause harm — a synonym of deleterious, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Harmful (हानिकारक): causing or likely to cause harm — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Damaging (नुकसानदायक): causing damage or injury — close in sense to deleterious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of deleterious: harmful, damaging, detrimental, injurious, noxious.

• Synonyms of harmless: safe, innocuous, benign, inoffensive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Immoral (अनैतिक): Decent (नैतिक)

2. Immune (सुरक्षित): Susceptible (असुरक्षित)

3. Immutable (अपरिवर्तनीय): Alterable (परिवर्तनीय), Changeable (बदलने योग्य)

4. Impecunious (निर्धन): Wealthy (धनी), Rich (समृद्ध)

5. Imperious (घमंडी): Meek (विनम्र), Submissive (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Obtuse".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Astute.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Obtuse" means slow to understand; lacking sharpness of intellect. (मूर्ख)

◦ Example: He seemed obtuse during the discussion, missing the obvious implications of the new policy.

 

• "Astute" means having sharp judgment or perception; shrewd, and is therefore the correct antonym. (चतुर)

◦ Example: The astute investor recognized the market trend long before her competitors noticed it.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Unintelligent (निर्बुद्धि): not clever; lacking intelligence — a synonym of obtuse, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Dense (अल्पबुद्धि): stupid or slow to understand — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Dull (मंदबुद्धि): lacking sharpness of mind — close in sense to obtuse.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of obtuse: dull, dense, unintelligent, slow-witted, dim-witted.

• Synonyms of astute: shrewd, perceptive, sharp, clever, insightful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Impervious (अभेद्य): Permeable (भेद्य), Penetrable (आर-पार होने योग्य)

2. Impetus (प्रोत्साहन): Caution (सावधानी), Hindrance (बाधा)

3. Improvement (सुधार): Deterioration (बिगाड़), Decline (गिरावट)

4. Impute (आरोप लगाना): Defend (बचाव करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना)

5. Impute (दोष देना): Defend (बचाव करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Enthralled."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Bored.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Enthralled" means captivated or fascinated by something; spellbound. (मोहित)

 

• "Bored" means feeling weary and impatient due to lack of interest. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उबाऊ)

◦ Example: The students grew bored during the long lecture and began checking their phones under the desk.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Fascinated (आकर्षित) — intensely interested; a synonym of enthralled.

• Option 3: Spellbound (मंत्रमुग्ध) — so impressed that one cannot think of anything else; a synonym of enthralled.

• Option 4: Captivated (मोहित) — attracted and held the attention of; a synonym of enthralled.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of enthralled: Uninterested, Weary, Indifferent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Incandescent (दीप्तिमान): Dusky (अंधकारमय), Dim (मंद)

2. Incessant (निरंतर): Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर), Occasional (कभी-कभी)

3. Incipient (प्रारंभिक): Advanced (उन्नत), Developed (विकसित)

4. Inclement (कठोर): Mild (मृदु), Pleasant (सुखद)

5. Incoherent (असंगत): Rational (तर्कसंगत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Camouflage."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Reveal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Camouflage" means disguise or conceal something by blending it with surroundings. (छिपाना)

 

• "Reveal" means make previously unknown information known. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रकट करना)

◦ Example: The journalist decided to reveal the source of her information despite pressure to keep it secret.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Disguise (भेस बदलना) — change appearance to hide identity; a synonym of camouflage.

• Option 2: Conceal (छिपाना) — keep something from being seen; a synonym of camouflage.

• Option 3: Mask (नकाब) — cover or hide something; a synonym of camouflage.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of camouflage: Expose, Uncover, Disclose.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Incorrigible (असुधार्य): Reclaimable (सुधार योग्य), Correctable (सुधारने योग्य)

2. Incredible (अद्भुत): Ordinary (साधारण), Normal (सामान्य)

3. Indict (आरोप लगाना): Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Acquit (बरी करना)

4. Indispensable (अति आवश्यक): Superfluous (अनावश्यक), Inessential (गैर-जरूरी)

5. Indolent (आलसी): Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (मेहनती)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Affirm".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Refuse.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Affirm" means to state something positively and confidently as being true. (पुष्टि करना)

◦ Example: The witness continued to affirm that she had clearly seen the suspect leaving the building.

 

• "Refuse" means to indicate unwillingness to do or accept something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (इंकार करना)

◦ Example: He flatly refused to sign the agreement without first consulting his own lawyer.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Declare (घोषणा करना): to state something formally or emphatically — a synonym of affirm, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Confirm (पुष्टि करना): to establish the truth of something — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Assert (दृढ़ता से कहना): to state a fact confidently — close in sense to affirm.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of affirm: Assert, Confirm, Declare, Maintain, Avow.

• Synonyms of refuse: Decline, Reject, Deny, Rebuff, Spurn.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ineffable (अकथनीय): Expressible (कहने योग्य), Definable (परिभाषित करने योग्य)

2. Ineluctable (अनिवार्य): Avoidable (टालने योग्य), Preventable (रोकने योग्य)

3. Inevitable (अनिवार्य): Avoidable (टालने योग्य), Preventable (रोकने योग्य)

4. Infernal (बहुत बुरा): Heavenly (स्वर्गीय), Divine (दैवीय)

5. Infirm (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Healthy (स्वस्थ)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Desecrate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Sanctify.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Desecrate" means to treat a sacred place or thing with violent disrespect. (अपवित्र करना)

 

• "Sanctify" means to set apart as sacred; to make holy. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पवित्र करना)

◦ Example: The priest performed a special ceremony to sanctify the new temple before it opened to worshippers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Defile (अपवित्र करना) — to make dirty or impure; a synonym of desecrate.

• Option 3: Violate (उल्लंघन करना) — to break or fail to respect; a synonym of desecrate.

• Option 4: Profane (धर्म का अनादर करना) — to treat something sacred with disrespect; a synonym of desecrate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of desecrate: Purify, Consecrate, Bless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Inflate (फुलाना): Reduce (कम करना), Deflate (सिकुड़ना)

2. Influenced (प्रभावित): Bipartisan (द्विपक्षीय/निष्पक्ष)

3. Inherent (अंतर्निहित): Extraneous (बाहरी)

4. Inhibit (रोकना): Allow (अनुमति देना), Approve (स्वीकृत करना)

5. Innate (जन्मजात): Learned (सीखा हुआ), Acquired (अर्जित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Attracts."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Deters.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Attracts" means draws interest, attention, or liking by having an appealing quality. (आकर्षित करता है)

 

• "Deters" means discourages someone from an action through fear of its consequences. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रोकता है)

◦ Example: The high entrance fee deters many budget travelers from visiting the famous museum during peak season.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Draws (खींचता है) — pulls or attracts attention or interest; a synonym of attracts.

• Option 3: Allures (लुभाता है) — powerfully attracts or tempts; a synonym of attracts.

• Option 4: Charms (मोहित करता है) — delights greatly and attracts; a synonym of attracts.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of attracts: Repels, Discourages, Dissuades.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Innocuous (हानिरहित): Harmful (हानिकारक), Dangerous (खतरनाक)

2. Inquisitive (जिज्ञासु): Indifferent (उदासीन), Ignorant (अज्ञानी)

3. Insatiable (अतृप्त): Satisfiable (संतुष्ट किया जा सकने वाला)

4. Insert (डालना): Remove (हटाना)

5. Insipid (फीका): Appetizing (स्वादिष्ट), Flavorful (स्वादपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Pulchritude".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Ugliness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Pulchritude" means great physical beauty and appeal. (सुंदरता)

◦ Example: Poets throughout history have praised the pulchritude of the countryside in springtime with vivid imagery.

 

• "Ugliness" means the quality of being unattractive or unpleasant to look at, and is therefore the correct antonym. (कुरूपता)

◦ Example: The ugliness of the abandoned factory contrasted sharply with the pristine gardens nearby.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Loveliness (मनोहरता): the quality of being beautiful or attractive — a synonym of pulchritude, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Beauty (सुंदरता): qualities that please the senses — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Attractiveness (आकर्षण): the quality of being pleasing or appealing — close in sense to pulchritude.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of pulchritude: beauty, loveliness, attractiveness, elegance, charm.

• Synonyms of ugliness: unattractiveness, hideousness, unsightliness, repulsiveness, homeliness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Intelligible (समझने योग्य): Incoherent (असंगत)

2. Intense (तीव्र): Moderate (मध्यम)

3. Intentional (जानबूझकर): Unplanned (अनायास), Accidental (दुर्घटनावश)

4. Interesting (दिलचस्प): Monotonous (नीरस), Boring (उबाऊ)

5. Interruption (रुकावट): Continuation (निरंतरता), Flow (प्रवाह)
